items.headline: Midterm election results increase scrutiny of AI data-center expansion and pressure AI-linked shares
items.summary: The Democratic midterm victory raised concerns that Congress and state governments could slow data-center development. Nvidia, Lam Research and other AI-buildout companies swung sharply, while hyperscalers such as Amazon performed better.
items.tag: AI infrastructure; policy risk; portfolio exposure

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces increased congressional scrutiny over alleged Chinese intelligence links
items.summary: Axios reported that congressional scrutiny of Jensen Huang is intensifying after reports alleging that a person connected to him was recruited to spy for China. Nvidia denied that the relationship involved anything beyond normal business contact and said no sensitive information was shared; the Chinese government also denied involvement.
